title.en: HR Already at 170 — Loop 1 Barely Done

tip.en: At just 0.7 km you're already at 170 bpm — your recent 8-run average HR is 139. The small climb (~9% grade) through this loop segment is driving a disproportionate cardiac response; ease the uphill effort on the first few laps to protect the remaining 7+ km.
tip.zh: 仅跑0.7公里心率已达170，而你近期平均心率为139。这段小坡（坡度约9%）带来了过大的心脏负荷，建议前几圈上坡时主动放慢，为后面7公里以上的距离保留余量。

title.en: Peak HR 176 — Uphill on Lap 2 Redline
title.zh: 第二圈上坡冲顶，心率176触顶

tip.en: This is the run's HR ceiling at 176 bpm, reached mid-climb on lap 2 at km 1.9 — far earlier than it should appear in an 8 km effort. Your only recent run to come close was the Oct 21 workout at 185 max; here you've hit near-max before even a quarter distance. This signals the opening pace was too aggressive for a doubled-distance day.
tip.zh: 这是本次跑步心率最高点176，出现在第二圈上坡、仅1.9公里处——在8公里的跑量下，这个爆发出现得过早。你近期唯一接近的一次是10月21日的185最高心率，而今天在未到四分之一距离时就几乎触顶，说明在加倍距离的日子里起跑节奏太激进。

title.en: HR Settling Into Lap 3 — Body Finding Rhythm
title.zh: 第三圈心率回落，身体找到节奏

tip.en: By km 2.7 HR has backed off to 165 and pace is steadying around 5:40-6:00/km — a healthy sign that you recalibrated after the hot start. This is the zone you should have entered from the first lap; note it as your sustainable circuit pace for future stadium sessions.
tip.zh: 到2.7公里时心率回落至165，配速稳定在5:40-6:00/公里——这是热身过度后自我调节的良好信号。这个区间本应从第一圈就保持；记录下来，作为未来操场圈跑的可持续目标节奏。

title.en: Laps 4-5: HR Flattening at 162 — Aerobic Ceiling Reached
title.zh: 第4-5圈心率稳定在162——有氧上限

tip.en: Around km 4.2 you've been holding 160-165 bpm for over 2 km of laps — this is likely your current aerobic ceiling at this loop intensity. The repeated 5-9% grade punches are keeping HR elevated even as your legs adapt; consider this your honest Zone 4 marker for hilly loop work.
tip.zh: 约4.2公里处，你已在160-165心率区间维持超过2公里——这很可能是你在此圈路线强度下的有氧上限。反复出现的5-9%坡度持续拉高心率，即使双腿已适应；将此视为坡道圈跑中你真实的四区标志。

title.en: Mid-Run Pause at km 5.8 — Walk Break or Gear Check
title.zh: 5.8公里处中途暂停——步行或调整装备

tip.en: Pace spikes to 23:09 then null between seconds 1992-2010, with HR dropping from 158 to 148 in under 30 seconds — a clear stop. After resuming, HR falls further to 145 and pace is restored cleanly, suggesting a deliberate rather than distress-driven break. On a volume-doubling day, this was a smart reset; just note that total time loses ~90 seconds here.
tip.zh: 1992-2010秒之间配速突然跳至23:09再到空值，心率在30秒内从158降至148——明显停了下来。恢复后心率进一步降至145，配速顺利回归，说明这是主动休息而非体力透支。在距离翻倍的训练日，这次重置是明智的；只是总计时损失了约90秒。

title.en: Late-Run HR Creep Back to 165 — Fatigue Drift
title.zh: 跑步后段心率回升至165——疲劳性漂移

tip.en: At km 7.8 your HR climbs back to 165 despite pace being similar to km 4-5. This cardiac drift — same effort, higher HR — is a classic sign of accumulated fatigue over a distance 72% longer than your recent average. It's not dangerous here, but it marks the threshold where further distance would start degrading form.
tip.zh: 7.8公里时心率重新爬升至165，而配速与第4-5公里相近。在同等努力下心率更高，这是典型的疲劳性心率漂移——本次跑量比近期均值长72%。目前尚不危险，但这标志着若再继续跑下去，跑姿开始恶化的临界点。

title.zh: 最后一圈收尾——有控制的减速

tip.en: From km 8.0 onward pace balloons to 10:58 → 18:07 and then GPS drifts during what appears to be a cooldown walk. HR holds at 167 briefly before descending to 142 by the final recorded point — a reasonable cardiac recovery arc. For an 8 km loop session on a day your avg recent distance was 4.7 km, completing the full distance is the real win here.
tip.zh: 从8公里起配速跌至10:58→18:07，随后GPS显示放缓至步行冷身。心率在167短暂维持后，到最后记录点降至142——心脏恢复曲线合理。在近期平均距离仅4.7公里的基础上完成8公里的操场圈跑，完赛本身就是今天最大的收获。
